title: FAQ: Gold Plus Account
summary: FAQ for the Gold Plus Account. It states you earn 6.0% APY on eligible balances, must maintain a $25,000 minimum (otherwise a $15 monthly maintenance fee may apply), includes automatic investment sweeps, and offers a 25% discount on eligible Rho-Bank brokerage trading commissions.
faqs: What APY do I earn on my Gold Plus balance?
